gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya has a visibly gaping c and a friendly, modern manner, set under Cherry Swash's horseshoe-shaped display letters. Cherry Swash is the louder of the two.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Wide-open, horseshoe-shaped c's give Cherry Swash a commanding look, while Noto Sans Hatran adds a funnel-throated e in plain sans-serif form. The heading's joins stay smooth and unpinched.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Twine-like strokes, bold and rounded. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi sits beneath Cherry Swash in sans form, with small counters that stay clear, so a heading may look best sized well above the body text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-javanes: Cherry Swash opens with a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, so every stroke carries the same visual weight. And Noto Sans Javanese keeps its counters connected to the space outside, which lets a longer passage move along smoothly.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Commanding rods of letters, not carved blades, make up Cherry Swash, with a c opened like a horseshoe. And Noto Sans Kawi has its own open-jawed c, so a tiny heading would lose the swagger that its body text never had.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-linear-: Noto Sans Linear A shows a visibly gaping c at any size. Cherry Swash above it draws every stroke with a neon-tube consistency, and that uniform, glowing line is the strongest quality here.

Distinctive from the first glance, Cherry Swash has horseshoe c's and strokes whose bold and light looks never mix within a word. Noto Sans Linear B, in sans, is the quieter specialist, sending the eye smoothly and unobstructed around each bend.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-manicha: Bent-paperclip strokes with a horseshoe c, loud and distinctive. Noto Sans Manichaean follows in plain sans, its e crossbars with open mouths, and that modern, clean openness is the strongest quality.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-mongoli: Noto Sans Mongolian flares its terminals outward. Under Cherry Swash, whose strokes have the steadiness of a drawn string, a longer passage would read in a modern, neutral way with a little lift at each stroke end.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Noto Sans New Tai Lue has round letters that look cupped, not clenched, and they sit beneath Cherry Swash's commanding horseshoe c. Together the heading hums while the body stays soft.
